Generation Maine · Identity v5

On the Record

The project is young Mainers telling their own stories on camera. The one symbol of that is the light that says a camera is recording. It becomes the brand's only shape. News cues make it credible to Maine Wire readers. Big type and color blocks carry the website until there are photos.

Why the dot

It is neutral, native to phones and cannot be read as partisan. It is also the dot on the i you liked in Spruce & Signal.

Why news cues

Chyrons, datelines and heavy rules say "real people, real places". Older readers trust them; younger viewers see them in every news clip.

What was cut

The swirls (decoration with no meaning), the ballot oval (reads as electoral) and the pink.

01 The mark

A wordmark with a live light

The heavy wordmark from Spruce & Signal. The dot on the i in "Maine" is the record light, now in Amber. The G icon carries the same dot for avatars and favicons.

02 The element system

One shape, three news cues, big type

The record dot

The only shape in the system. Amber, always a perfect circle. It is the live indicator, the bullet, the period at the end of a headline and the section marker. It pulses slowly only when something is live or coming soon. One large dot per screen at most.

The live pill

Dot plus a short label in caps on Ink: ON THE RECORD, RECORDING SOON, NEW EPISODE. Header, thumbnails and the first second of every video.

The chyron

Two bars, like a TV news lower third: the name in Bricolage on Paper with an Amber edge, the hometown in caps on Spruce. Every creator appearance uses it, on video and on the website.
Rumford, Maine

Datelines and rules

Place is set as type, the way a newspaper opens a story: TOWN, MAINE in caps. A heavy rule over a thin rule opens major sections. This replaces the swirl texture: place is named, not decorated.
Building a life here

Big type and color blocks

With no photos, scale does the work: headlines at 90 to 150 px on desktop, full-width blocks of Spruce, Paper and Amber, and numbered sections (01, 02, 03). This is what makes the page feel designed rather than empty.

Spruce 45 · Paper 30 · Ink 10 · Amber 10 · Moss 5. Amber on Spruce 5.9:1, Ink on Amber 10.7:1, Paper on Spruce 9.3:1. All pass WCAG AA.

Bricolage Grotesque ExtraBold

Headlines, names, the wordmark. Tight, sentence case, big.

Inter

Body text, labels, datelines and chyron bottoms. Caps with wide tracking for labels.

Both under the SIL Open Font License. Both already self-hosted in the theme. No italics anywhere.

04 Rules

DoUse one large dot per screen, as a period or a live light.
Don'tScatter dots as decoration or make them any color but Amber.
DoName places in datelines: BANGOR, MAINE.
Don'tAdd maps, outlines, mountains or swirl textures.
DoUse the chyron for every creator appearance.
Don'tUse the pill to say VOTE or to point at any candidate or measure.
DoLet headlines run huge and let color blocks fill the width.
Don'tFill empty space with stock photos or patterns.
DoKeep "An initiative of Maine Policy Institute" on every piece.
Don'tUse italics, gradients or drop shadows.
